column1: # Nine Commits, post 3 — every run behind the numbers in index.mdx.
# 42 runs of one question against gpt-5-mini at commit v3-the-loop:
#   "Which file in this project sets the model name the agent uses, and what is it set to?"
# It is post 2's question, unchanged, with TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS=precise — post 2's
# precise condition. The only new variable is the loop.
# WRITTEN BY THE AGENT, not typed out of a terminal. agent/src/cli.ts appends
# one row per run to agent/traces/runs.tsv, and this file is that log with this
# comment block in front of it. The rows are in the order they ran.
# Row 1 is the run published as trace.json. It was the first run, and it was
# Rows 2-21 were run with TRACE_ID=tally, which overwrites one trace file, so
# their individual traces are gone. That was an instrumentation gap, not a
# choice: the tally records which tools were called and what the recorder
# graded, never what the tool results contained, and this post needed to know
# what the agent had READ. Rows 22-42 are the same command with a distinct
# TRACE_ID per run, so every trace survived. corpus-reach.tsv is derived from
# those 21. Nothing was changed between the two blocks; the corpus is the same
# repository in both, because the tools skip the directory the traces are
# steps is the number of model calls. At v2 it could not exceed 2.
# stopped_by is which condition ended the run: `model` means the model returned
# a step that asked for no tool, `step-cap` means MAX_STEPS fired mid-task.
# outcome is derived by agent/src/recorder.ts against
# success = the final answer carried both facts, partial = one, failure = none.
